title: Annual Survey of Industries
subtitle: Factory-sector output, employment and value added, by NIC industry and state
_keys: ASI is industry-keyed, not product-keyed. It has no HS code anywhere in it, so it cannot join to trade data directly - the bridge is config/concordances/hs6-nic5.csv, and until that file has rows the two datasets sit side by side rather than together. This is the honest position: NIC and HS classify different things (an activity versus a good) and no exact mapping exists.
_periodBasis: ASI reports Indian financial years, April to March - the same basis as the DGCIS tariff lines and NOT the same as Comtrade's calendar years.

surface._panels: Where this dataset offers blocks on someone else's page. `via` names the concordance that makes the match possible; the panel stays hidden while that concordance is empty.

panels.title: Domestic factory output
panels.note: Mapped from NIC industries; a product may draw on several industries and an industry on several products.

_status: declared means the manifest exists and the shell knows the shape, but no data has been ingested. Nothing renders for a declared dataset beyond a stub saying so.
